name: Planfly
description: Record and consult personal finances in planfly: expenses, income, transfers between accounts, net position and budgets, at both the BCV and P2P rates.

baseUrl.description: URL of your planfly. From another container, the container name on a shared network; from the same machine, http://localhost:3000

apiToken.description: A plfy_… token. The identity (household and user) is derived from it, never from a tool parameter.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time per request. Defaults to 10000.

defaultCurrency.description: Currency assumed when the message does not say. Defaults to VES.

confirmOver.description: Amount in base currency above which it is worth simulating (dry_run) and confirming before saving. Defaults to 100.
